title: Essential App for building good habits
body: I love this app. It reminds me to stay focused on my habits. Building habits is not that easy. I believe that this app will help me to succeed in my tasks.
author: Chandima_Dew

title: All good, except for the annoying ads which show up all the time
body: Happy with the app. Ads are a little too “in your face”.
author: Earth-to-earth

title: Been using the paid version for two years
body:
Hey guys,

Great app. 

Have been using for two years and fantastic.

Was wondering if we can see a bit more visualizations on the overall stats. That might push me to continue finishing all the habits through a period of time. 

But I’ve improved myself thanks to the app
author: Kaush_bataya

title: Thank you!
body: This app has really helped me keep track of my daily routines and make new habits which have helped me achieve a peace of mind and live a better life.
author: v_i_d_s

title: Issues with app
body: The app is not sync with calandar therefore it is hard to keep track. Hope this bug will be fixed.
author: riatasha
